verdict.rationale: Team admins can create organization-wide Bugbot rules in Bugbot Automations, and the Teams plan includes advanced rules, settings and effort-level controls, which supports org-level review defaults. Per-repo `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files allow repo-specific guidance, and verbose mode shows which rules loaded. However, nothing shows central exception management or bulk rollout across hundreds of repos. Missing for 10: documented central exception/override management per repo or team, bulk multi-repo enablement and policy inheritance details, independent hands-on corroboration of org-wide rollout at scale.
